title: Vision & Audio Fine-Tuning
description: Fine-tune vision and audio models with Soup CLI. LLaVA, ShareGPT4V, audio data formats. Pillow and librosa integrations. For Whisper speech-to-text fine-tuning see the dedicated ASR page (task: asr, v0.71.32).

blocks.html:
Vision & Audio Fine-Tuning

Vision / Multimodal

Fine-tune vision-language models (LLaMA-3.2-Vision, Qwen2-VL, Pixtral):

blocks.code:
base: meta-llama/Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct
task: sft
modality: vision

data:
  train: ./data/vision_train.jsonl
  format: llava
  image_dir: ./data/images
  val_split: 0.1

training:
  epochs: 3
  lr: 1e-5
  quantization: 4bit
  lora:
    r: 64
    alpha: 16
{"image": "photo.jpg", "conversations": [{"from": "human", "value": "<image>\nDescribe this image."}, {"from": "gpt", "value": "A cat on a mat."}]}

blocks.html:
A relative image path resolves against data.image_dir, or against the directory of the data file when image_dir is unset. A Hub dataset or a remote URI has no data file directory, so set data.image_dir when its rows hold image paths: since v0.76.0 the load stops with a message naming the setting if you set neither (data.image_dir: . resolves them under the working directory), and a row whose file lies outside the directory is skipped with the usual "rows skipped" warning. Before that, rows from a streaming data.interleave, a remote URI or a Hub dataset kept the path as written, so a relative path was opened against the working directory and image_dir had no effect. An image a Hub dataset has already decoded is passed on as before, and Parquet image structs ({"bytes": ..., "path": ...}) are accepted, their path following the same rules. The same holds for audio paths and data.audio_dir.

soup data inspect automatically shows image statistics (count, formats, missing files) for vision datasets, resolving paths the same way (or with --image-dir). The full path rule, including the remote URI, Hub dataset and replay-file cases, is on Data formats.

Vision and audio SFT supervise every sequence token: the multimodal collators do no assistant-only masking, so data.train_on_responses_only and data.mask_history have no effect there (#1156). Since v0.77.0 soup doctor --config lists only data.mask_history as ignored on modality: vision or audio (#1791 dropped the train_on_responses_only row); through v0.76.1 it listed both. training.moe_lora, rope_scaling_type, freeze_layers and freeze_ratio are refused at config load on vision and audio SFT.

Three more refusals at config load since v0.77.0:

  • backend: unsloth with modality: vision or audio on SFT (#2015): the vision and audio setup paths load through transformers and never used Unsloth, so such a run silently ran on transformers. The setting loaded and was never applied: use backend: transformers, which changes nothing about what trains.
  • llava and sharegpt4v rows on preference tasks (dpo, ipo, simpo, orpo, bco, preference; #2064): they have no vision-preference row path, so use a text preference format. On v0.76 such a run failed after the model had loaded. The pixtral-dpo recipe was retired with it.
  • modality: vision or audio with task: distill (#2014): the distill trainer loads a text-only student and teacher, so the setting was never applied and deleting it changes nothing about what trains.

Audio / Speech

Fine-tune audio-language models (Qwen2-Audio, Whisper):

blocks.code:
base: Qwen/Qwen2-Audio-7B-Instruct
task: sft
modality: audio

data:
  train: ./data/audio_train.jsonl
  format: audio
  audio_dir: ./data/audio
  val_split: 0.1

training:
  epochs: 3
  lr: 1e-5
  quantization: 4bit
  lora:
    r: 64
    alpha: 16

blocks.html:
A relative audio path resolves against data.audio_dir (or the data file's directory) by the same rule as image paths: see Data formats.

Want to fine-tune Whisper itself (speech-to-text, not audio understanding)? That is a dedicated task since v0.71.32: see ASR fine-tuning (task: asr, format: asr, built-in WER/CER, whisper-tiny/base train on a 4 GB GPU).

Continued Pre-training

Continue training on raw text for domain adaptation:

blocks.code:
base: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B
task: pretrain

data:
  train: ./data/corpus.jsonl     # {"text": "..."} or plain .txt files
  format: plaintext
  max_length: 4096

training:
  epochs: 1
  lr: 1e-5
  quantization: 4bit

blocks.html:
Embedding Fine-Tuning

Train sentence embedding models with contrastive learning:

blocks.code:
base: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2
task: embedding

data:
  train: ./data/embeddings.jsonl
  format: embedding

training:
  embedding_loss: contrastive    # contrastive, triplet, cosine
  embedding_pooling: mean
  embedding_margin: 0.5
  embedding_temperature: 0.05

{"anchor": "What is Python?", "positive": "Python is a programming language."}
{"anchor": "What is Python?", "positive": "A programming language.", "negative": "A type of snake."}

blocks.html:
embedding_loss: contrastive (the default) needs other rows in the batch as negatives, so since v0.76.0 batch_size: 1 is refused at config load (#1234): with one row the loss and gradient are exactly 0 and the adapter never moves. batch_size: auto resolves to at least 2, the last partial batch of an epoch is dropped, and a batch larger than the training set is lowered to its size. Use triplet (with negative rows) or cosine for a batch of 1.
